support.notes: Exact Steam pin of the public head observed 2026-09-24 (native Linux dedicated server; depot 443032 manifest 2389917983000609164). The bridge is contract-level proven on every build by the fake-RCON/fake-Takaro suite; it was last re-proven at startup level in an isolated dev-servers rig on build 25356024: target stamp, identify with hosted Takaro, reachability over RCON, an empty player list, a console command, reconnect after a dropped socket, and a Takaro shutdown that exits the server process cleanly (slowly: about four and a half minutes). This bridge speaks RCON and does not compile against any server assembly, so nothing about the repin itself needed a code change. Chat delivery needs Enhanced Pippi plus the helper, the Takaro-owned TakaroConan.pak needs the Windows Epic DevKit and is not part of this target, and gameplay-level events are unverified. `takaro-maint verify --game conan-exiles` waits for the shared runner seam that lets a game name its container command and options; the adapter already ships both hooks.

notes: One image serves both containers: the dedicated server is a self-contained UE5 Linux build that needs only glibc/libstdc++, so it runs in the same pinned Node image the bridge needs; the rig and the verifier start it by command (ConanSandboxServer.sh). The Steamworks redist depot 1006 is pinned because the proven install carried it; it is not watched (Valve's depot).
